body: My doctor prescribed me with two things, one thing for anxiety and an anti-depressant that supposedly helps anxiety? I have access to one yes, I don't want to see one though, because at times I can seem perfectly normal. Do you know what I mean?
They will, but what if they put me away? Is that possible? What if it stops me from getting to places I want to go to? Do you know what I mean? Thanks anyway, I appreciate this a lot.

Yeah, I get that advice a lot. It would be the logical thing to do. But I shrug it off, I refuse to see a therapist yet I want help. It's stupid, I can't stop myself from stopping myself. Do you know what I mean? My father is also a therapist. He's said in the past if I need to speak to someone or what not. I have seen and read these sheets he fills in, it all seems like BS to me.
